input.quote: Fees do not include taxes, reimbursable expenses, service credits, interest, damages, or a one-time implementation charge unless an Order Form expressly states otherwise.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination charge is payable by Customer anywhere in the Agreement: service credits are referenced only as amounts flowing to us (Section 1.5), Section 7.3 lets us withhold disputed amounts, and Section 27.3 allows termination for force majeure "without penalty". Compliant as drafted; the take-or-pay in Section 2.1 is addressed under MINCOMMIT, and our T4C insert expressly states termination carries no early-termination charge so it cannot be recharacterised as a penalty.

input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets our preferred position: professional and workmanlike performance, material conformance to documentation for Deliverables for 90 days (and for hosted Services throughout the subscription term, which is better than a 12-month software warranty), no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, and a re-perform/repair/replace-or-refund remedy in 19.4 that is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The 19.5 disclaimer expressly does not cut down express warranties. No redline needed.
